requirements_delivered.REQ-005: Practice view with custom drills, worked solutions, per-distractor rationales, confidence capture and an error notebook. All exercised by vitest and a Playwright E2E flow.
requirements_delivered.REQ-006: Exam simulation domain rules in vector-domain::exam plus the CAT/paper UI. CAT forbids backtracking and commits each answer; paper allows review and revision. Timing profiles are versioned and source-dated.
requirements_delivered.REQ-029: Crash center surfaces redaction status and per-report pass count, and blocks sharing while a report still contains secrets.
requirements_delivered.REQ-035: Accessibility settings (contrast, motion, focus, verbose announcements, spacing, font scale) plus a portable local export control and a fully-deleting delete path gated behind a typed confirmation.
requirements_delivered.REQ-044: Local full-text search across lessons, error notebook and evidence, with category filters, prefix matching, deterministic ranking and snippets.

requirements_deferred_with_reason.REQ-030: The repair-bundle consent manifest UI entry point exists in the privacy center, but deterministic bundle generation (diagnostics, repro steps, hashes) is EP-008 work. No bundle is produced by this node and none is claimed.
requirements_deferred_with_reason.REQ-031: The repair broker (isolated worktree + coding agent + GraphLock) is EP-008 work. The PR record store it will use landed in EP-003; no broker runs here.
requirements_deferred_with_reason.REQ-034: Forced-termination and corruption recovery are covered at the persistence layer by EP-003 (WAL, digest-verified restore, corruption rejection). No EP-005 UI recovery flow is claimed beyond that.

stub_check.note: No stub or placeholder production behaviour was added. A previous vacuous test (expect(true).toBe(true)) was deleted and replaced with real DOM-driven assertions. Views whose content belongs to a later node render an explicitly labelled 'delivered by a later node' note rather than fabricated content.

thin_test_check.note: 111 tests across three suites. Behaviour is asserted through roles, accessible names and user events rather than implementation details, so the tests fail when real behaviour breaks (proven by 13/13 detected mutations).

evidence_sticker_check.note: Evidence is real command output with exit codes and SHA-256 hashes. The E2E suite runs against the production `dist/` bundle served by vite preview, not a dev server, so the artifact itself is exercised.

test_weakening_check.note: No assertion was deleted, skipped or loosened. The vacuous placeholder test was replaced with stronger coverage; two tests that carried an unused setup variable were strengthened to actually drive the interaction.

real_defects_found_and_fixed: Playwright could not start the preview server: vite preview binds to `localhost`, which resolved to IPv6 ::1 only, while Playwright probed IPv4 127.0.0.1, producing a 120s startup timeout rather than a test failure. The host is now pinned explicitly to 127.0.0.1 in both the command and the base URL.
test:e2e was referenced by scripts/test-e2e.sh but did not exist in any package.json, so the E2E gate could never pass. The script is now defined at both the root and the desktop package.
The exam timer had a setState function that was never wired up, so the countdown never ran. It is now a real interval that saturates at zero and submits the exam, matching the domain rules.
Clipy flagged ExamSession::next() as confusable with std::iter::Iterator::next; renamed to advance() for an unambiguous public API.
Three unused-variable typecheck errors (TS6133) blocked the build; the tests that carried them were strengthened rather than silenced.

validator_defect_found_and_fixed.defect: The placeholder-residue check (already narrowed once during EP-004 for nested JSON) then flagged legitimate TypeScript template literals such as `${id}` and `${optionIndex}` as unrendered placeholders, failing preflight against correct, executable UI source.
validator_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: The `${...}` pattern is now scoped by file suffix: it applies only to formats that cannot execute it (.md, .txt, .yaml, .yml, .rst, .csv) and is skipped for source formats.
validator_defect_found_and_fixed.is_this_gate_weakening: NO, and it is proven. .agent/evidence/EP-004/placeholder-check-proof.py was extended to 8 cases covering every placeholder shape plus both known false-positive classes, asserting that genuine residue still FAILS in a document while real interpolation syntax PASSES in code. 8/8 behaved as required.
validator_defect_found_and_fixed.proof_note: The proof caught this regression itself: it initially failed on its own .sh fixture, which is what revealed that a shell script legitimately contains `${...}`.

known_limitations: The UI runs against sample data in apps/desktop/src/data/sample.ts. It is not yet wired to the Rust persistence layer through Tauri IPC; that integration belongs to the desktop-shell work that follows. No end-to-end claim is made that a learner's real attempts reach SQLite from the UI.

Several views (onboarding, diagnostic, lesson, explore, evidence, tutor, content, providers) are registered in navigation with an explicit 'delivered by a later node' note. They are reachable and keyboard-operable but their content is not built.
The test-mode chrome suppression is asserted as 'the exam view renders without the today-plan chrome alongside it'. Full distraction suppression across every view is not claimed.

Human accessibility validation (PREFLIGHT PF-017) remains an external gate. Automated checks cover roles, names, keyboard operation and ARIA attributes; they do not replace testing with assistive-technology users.
